d: Company Description Novelty specializes in designing and manufacturing customized interior solutions, including kitchens, wardrobes, TV units, and bespoke furniture, all produced locally in Kuwait with a strong focus on precision and quality. As a sister company of Final Touches Group, one of Kuwait’s leading furniture industry names, Novelty benefits from enhanced capabilities and high standards in design and production. The company operates a fully integrated production facility supported by a dedicated team of designers and engineers who turn concepts into functional, visually appealing spaces. Novelty collaborates closely with homeowners, interior designers, and contractors to deliver tailored solutions that balance aesthetics and practicality, offering applicants the opportunity to contribute to distinctive residential and commercial projects.

Role Description The Installation Manager is responsible for overseeing the end-to-end installation of kitchens, wardrobes, TV units, and custom furniture, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to quality standards. This full-time, on-site role based in Kuwait City involves coordinating installation schedules, supervising installation teams, and verifying that work aligns with technical drawings, design specifications, and safety requirements. The role includes liaising with designers, engineers, contractors, and clients to clarify requirements, resolve site issues, and manage changes or constraints that arise during installation. The Installation Manager will monitor materials and tools availability, perform site inspections, document progress, and maintain accurate records to support efficient project execution. The position also requires identifying process improvements and contributing to best practices that enhance installation quality and customer satisfaction.
q: Experience in managing installation projects for interiors or furniture, including site supervision, scheduling, and coordination with cross-functional teams.

Solid organizational and time-management skills, with the capacity to handle multiple projects and prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.

Knowledge of relevant health, safety, and quality standards, and a commitment to enforcing safe work practices on-site.
Proficiency in basic project documentation, reporting, and use of common office and project management software tools.
Previous experience in the interior design, furniture manufacturing, construction, or fit-out industry is highly beneficial.
Relevant diploma or degree in engineering, interior design, construction management, or a related field preferred, or equivalent practical experience.
Ability to work on-site in Kuwait City, with flexibility to visit multiple project locations as needed.
